evidence_quotes: GLB. Randvoorwaarden. Bewijs ontbreekt dat appellante artikel 8a van het Besluit gebruik meststoffen heeft overtreden.
rationale: Dutch CBb decision concerning Common Agricultural Policy (GLB) cross-compliance (randvoorwaarden) and an alleged violation of Article 8a of the Besluit gebruik meststoffen (Decree on the Use of Fertilizers/Manure), along with evidentiary and procedural hearing requirements. Agricultural fertilizer/manure compliance disputes are not substantively water law or water governance.
